152: $n$ relations.

224: The main goal of this paper is to give a concise and root-system
225: uniform extension of Borel's presentation that produces for arbitrary
226: $w\in W$ an abbreviated list of generators for $I_w$.  Our first main
227: result, Theorem~\ref{general-bound}, achieves this via a strong
228: restriction on the {\bf descent set}
229: $$
230: \Des(u):=\{ s \in S: \ell(us) < \ell(u) \}
231: $$ of the elements $u$ in $W$ that index elements in our list of ideal
232: generators $\sigma_u$ for $I_w$.  We will need the following
233: definitions, the first two of which are standard:
234: \begin{enumerate}
235: \item[$\bullet$]
236: An element $u\in W$ is {\bf grassmannian} if $|\Des(u)| \leq 1$.
237: \item[$\bullet$]
238: An element $v \in W$ is {\bf bigrassmannian} if both $v$ and $v^{-1}$ are grassmannian.  
239: \item[$\bullet$]
240: Given $w \in W$, the {\bf essential set for} $w$, denoted
241: $\Ess(w)$, is the set of $u\in W$ which are minimal in the Bruhat order among those
242: {\it not} below $w$.
243: \end{enumerate}
